questions.explanation: 根据后文教练让她故意输球、教对手如何击败她等打破常规的训练方法可知，教练在教她如何“以不同的方式”思考。易错点：B项容易因固定思维选择，但后文体现的是unconventional（不拘一格），而非单纯的逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(differently)：语境句：We need to think differently to solve this problem. 固定搭配：think differently, act differently
B(logically)：语境句：He argued logically and convinced everyone. 固定搭配：think logically, reason logically
C(thoroughly)：语境句：The police investigated the case thoroughly. 固定搭配：thoroughly understand, thoroughly clean
D(seriously)：语境句：You must take this matter seriously. 固定搭配：take sth seriously, seriously injured

questions.explanation: 下文教练提到“You're concentrating on grunting(发出哼声)”，grunting即指击球时发出的“噪音(noises)”。
questions.supplement:
A(mistakes)：语境句：Everyone makes mistakes in the learning process. 固定搭配：make mistakes, learn from mistakes
B(noises)：语境句：The strange noises outside kept me awake all night. 固定搭配：make noises, background noises
C(gestures)：语境句：He made hand gestures to express his excitement. 固定搭配：make a gesture, hand gestures
D(faces)：语境句：The little boy made funny faces to make his sister laugh. 固定搭配：make faces, see familiar faces

questions.explanation: 前句作者已经回答了“no”（没生病），然后紧接着“补充说(added)”听说发声能增加力量。此处表示在原回答基础上的补充说明。
questions.supplement:
A(hesitated)：语境句：She hesitated for a moment before answering the question. 固定搭配：hesitate to do sth, hesitate about sth
B(repeated)：语境句：The teacher repeated the instructions to make sure everyone understood. 固定搭配：repeat after me, repeat mistakes
C(added)：语境句："And don't be late," she added with a smile. 固定搭配：add to, add up to
D(played)：语境句：The children played happily in the garden. 固定搭配：play a role, play against

questions.explanation: 教练紧接着说“You're not doing any better with it(你并没有因此打得更好)”，说明作者认为发声能增加力量的想法是“错误的(wrong)”。
questions.supplement:
A(correct)：语境句：Please choose the correct answer from the options. 固定搭配：correct answer, absolutely correct
B(wrong)：语境句：It is wrong to judge people by their appearance. 固定搭配：go wrong, prove sb wrong
C(creative)：语境句：The company is looking for a highly creative designer. 固定搭配：creative thinking, creative process
D(sensitive)：语境句：Dogs have a highly sensitive sense of smell. 固定搭配：sensitive to, sensitive skin

questions.explanation: 根据常识及前文“when I hit(当我击球时)”，教练批评她把注意力放在了发出哼声上，而不是放在“击球(hitting)”本身上。
questions.supplement:
A(hitting)：语境句：He is practicing hitting the baseball in the yard. 固定搭配：hit the ball, hit the target
B(jumping)：语境句：The kids were jumping up and down with joy. 固定搭配：jump up, jump to conclusions
C(picking)：语境句：She spent the afternoon picking strawberries in the field. 固定搭配：pick up, pick out
D(running)：语境句：He goes running in the park every morning. 固定搭配：run out of, run into

questions.explanation: 作者四岁开始打球，六岁参加第一场比赛，因此她已经“训练/练习(practising)”了两年。
questions.supplement:
A(complaining)：语境句：He is always complaining about the bad weather. 固定搭配：complain about, complain of
B(changing)：语境句：The weather in the mountains is constantly changing. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
C(recalling)：语境句：She smiled, recalling the happy moments of her childhood. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, beyond recall
D(practising)：语境句：She has been practising the piano for hours. 固定搭配：practise doing sth, practise medicine

questions.explanation: 后文提到“轻松的胜利学不到什么教训”，并且教练故意找了厉害的人把她打败，说明教练故意让她“输(lose)”。
questions.supplement:
A(defend)：语境句：The soldiers fought bravely to defend their country. 固定搭配：defend against, defend oneself
B(win)：语境句：We have a good chance to win the championship this year. 固定搭配：win a prize, win the match
C(lose)：语境句：It is painful to lose a game, but you learn from it. 固定搭配：lose face, lose control
D(regret)：语境句：I regret to inform you that your application was rejected. 固定搭配：regret doing sth, regret to say

questions.explanation: 为了确保能打败当时很自信的作者，教练故意找了一个有“经验丰富的(experienced)”女孩来和她比赛。
questions.supplement:
A(experienced)：语境句：We are looking for an experienced software engineer. 固定搭配：experienced in, highly experienced
B(ambitious)：语境句：The ambitious young man wants to be a CEO before 30. 固定搭配：ambitious plan, highly ambitious
C(outgoing)：语境句：She has an outgoing personality and makes friends easily. 固定搭配：outgoing personality, outgoing flights
D(informed)：语境句：Consumers should make informed choices when buying products. 固定搭配：informed decision, keep sb informed

questions.explanation: 11岁的作者跨年龄组去对战14岁的女孩，在此处指“比赛、竞争(competing)”。
questions.supplement:
A(observing)：语境句：The scientists are observing the behavior of the monkeys. 固定搭配：observe carefully, closely observe
B(doubting)：语境句：I am doubting whether he will keep his promise. 固定搭配：doubt if/whether, no doubt
C(competing)：语境句：Several companies are competing for the contract. 固定搭配：compete against/with, compete for
D(waiting)：语境句：I have been waiting for you for an hour. 固定搭配：wait for, wait in line

questions.explanation: 教练之所以告诉对手如何击败作者，是因为他“知道(knew)”作者如果在自己的弱点上输了球，就会更加关注这些弱点。这是教练对作者心理的准确把握。
questions.supplement:
A(warned)：语境句：The police warned drivers of the icy roads. 固定搭配：warn sb about sth, warn against
B(heard)：语境句：I heard that they are moving to London next month. 固定搭配：hear of, hear from
C(guessed)：语境句：She correctly guessed the answer to the riddle. 固定搭配：guess what, make a guess
D(knew)：语境句：He knew exactly what to do in an emergency. 固定搭配：know about, let me know

questions.explanation: 教练让对手打作者的低位正手，这是作者的“弱点(weaknesses)”。因为因弱点而输球，作者才会加以重视。
questions.supplement:
A(scores)：语境句：The final scores of the match were 3 to 1. 固定搭配：keep score, high scores
B(weaknesses)：语境句：We must recognize our own strengths and weaknesses. 固定搭配：fatal weakness, overcome weaknesses

D(strengths)：语境句：You should choose a career that plays to your strengths. 固定搭配：inner strength, physical strength

questions.explanation: 根据后文的“until I cried”和教练鼓励的“One day you'll catch her”可知，作者一直输给她，处于一直“追赶(catching)”她的状态。
questions.supplement:
A(missing)：语境句：I realized my wallet was missing when I got to the store. 固定搭配：go missing, be missing
B(beating)：语境句：His heart was beating fast before the performance. 固定搭配：beat the opponent, take a beating
C(inspiring)：语境句：His speech was truly inspiring and motivated us all. 固定搭配：inspiring story, inspire sb to do sth

questions.explanation: 作者不断输球，在这个过程中遭受挫折。教练喜欢看到作者受到“挑战(challenged)”的样子，因为这能激发她的斗志。
questions.supplement:

B(blamed)：语境句：He blamed himself for the failure of the project. 固定搭配：blame sb for sth, take the blame
C(challenged)：语境句：Students should be properly challenged to reach their potential. 固定搭配：challenge oneself, face a challenge
D(respected)：语境句：She is highly respected by her colleagues. 固定搭配：respect for, deeply respected

questions.explanation: 终于赢了宿敌之后，作者带着惊讶和满足的神情“转向(turned to)”教练，期待他的反应。
questions.supplement:
A(turned to)：语境句：When she was in trouble, she turned to her parents for help. 固定搭配：turn to sb for help, turn to page 10
B(looked after)：语境句：She stayed at home and looked after her sick mother. 固定搭配：look after oneself, well looked after

D(aimed at)：语境句：The new policy is aimed at reducing unemployment. 固定搭配：aim at doing sth, take aim at

questions.explanation: 文章主旨点题，呼应第二段的“lessons to be learned”。教练教给作者的这些宝贵的“教训/经验(lessons)”，无论输赢都在持续影响着她。
questions.supplement:
A(answers)：语境句：He couldn't find the answers to the math problems. 固定搭配：in answer to, the answer to the question
B(wishes)：语境句：Please send my best wishes to your family. 固定搭配：best wishes, express one's wishes

D(arguments)：语境句：They had heated arguments about politics. 固定搭配：have an argument, win an argument

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the splendid history of Chinese ceramics(陶瓷制品), there is a name that shines brilliantly — Jingdezhen. This ancient porcelain capital [56] the glory and heritage of a thousand years of porcelain culture.

Jingdezhen was formerly known as Xinping and got its name because the porcelain ware made for the court in the Jingde period of the Song dynasty [57] "Made in the Jingde period". Since then, the reputation of Jingde has spread through the country, becoming related to Chinese ceramics. The [58] of porcelain produced here is vast and of superb quality. For example, the elegant and delicate Yingqing porcelain with [59] mixture of blue and white colors resembles a painting from a fairyland.

During the Ming and Qing [60], Jingdezhen became the center [61] the national porcelain industry, attracting countless skilled craftsmen to contribute talents, and their porcelain-making techniques, [62] promoted Jingdezhen porcelain to unprecedented heights in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration.

Today, Jingdezhen still maintains its [63] position in the Chinese ceramics industry. Stepping into Jingdezhen is like entering a living epic of ceramics. The ancient kiln fire's(窑火的) exquisite craftsmanship [64] generations of creativity have [65] formed the glory and heritage of this millennium porcelain capital.

questions.explanation: 考查主谓一致和时态。主语为“This ancient porcelain capital”，表示客观事实和现在的状态，故使用一般现在时第三人称单数形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carries)：语境句：This tradition carries great cultural significance. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrier(n. 载体/航母), carriage(n. 马车/客车厢)。

questions.explanation: 考查动词被动语态和时态。主语the porcelain ware与name之间是被动关系（被命名为），且事情发生在宋朝景德年间，用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was named)：语境句：The boy was named after his grandfather. 固定搭配：be named after, name sb sth。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 即，也就是), nameless(adj. 无名的)。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。定冠词The之后需要名词作主语，vary的名词形式为variety，表示“种类/多样性”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(variety)：语境句：The supermarket offers a wide variety of fresh fruits. 固定搭配：a variety of, for a variety of reasons。原词vary其它变形：various(adj. 各种各样的), variable(adj. 多变的 n. 变量)。

questions.explanation: 考查代词。修饰名词短语mixture of blue and white colors，需要用形容词性物主代词，指代前面提到的Yingqing porcelain的混合色彩。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The company is famous for its high-quality products. 固定搭配：on its own, in its entirety。原词it其它变形：itself(pron. 它自己)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。前面的Ming and Qing指的是明清两个朝代，因此dynasty需要变成复数形式dynasties。
questions.supplement: 正确形(dynasties)：语境句：The Tang and Song dynasties were golden ages for Chinese poetry. 固定搭配：ancient dynasties, fall of dynasties。原词dynasty其它变形：dynastic(adj. 朝代的)。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。构成“the center of...”的结构，意为“……的中心”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(of)：语境句：Beijing is the political and cultural center of China. 固定搭配：the center of, a lot of, think of。本词无常见词形变化。

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后为非限制性定语从句，指代前面的先行词their porcelain-making techniques，在从句中作主语，故填which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, from which。本词无常见词形变化。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词/形容词作定语。修饰后面的名词position，表示“主导的、领先的”，用现在分词转化为形容词的leading。
questions.supplement: 正确形(leading)：语境句：She played a leading role in the success of the project. 固定搭配：leading role, leading position。原词lead其它变形：leader(n. 领导者), leadership(n. 领导力)。

questions.explanation: 考查并列连词。连接两个并列的名词短语“exquisite craftsmanship”与“generations of creativity”，表示并列关系，填and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：We need time and patience to solve this problem. 固定搭配：both...and, and so on。本词无常见词形变化。

questions.explanation: 考查副词。修饰谓语动词formed，需要将形容词joint变为副词jointly，表示“共同地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(jointly)：语境句：The report was jointly published by two major organizations. 固定搭配：jointly owned, work jointly。原词joint其它变形：joint(n. 关节 adj. 联合的), jointed(adj. 有接缝的)。
